outcome: confidence related to labour and birth
cohort: The study cohort consisted of primiparous women who were randomly allocated to one of two antenatal education programs or served as case-matched controls not attending education from October 2023 to May 2024.
finding: While childbirth education showed limited effects on most clinical outcomes, both programs improved women's knowledge and confidence for labour and birth.
mod_finding: No significant differences were found in caesarean section rates between education groups and controls, though significantly fewer women in the EmpowerEd group used epidurals compared to the CTP group.
